definition: גַּלְמוּד adjective hard, barren (Late Hebrew id. lonely NHWB ; Arabic rock , stony (of land); Aramaic גַּלְמוּדָה compare Ba NB 208 ) — ׳ ג Job 3:7 + 2 t. Job; feminine גַּלְמוּדָה Isa 49:21 — hard, barren, unproductive , mostly figurative: Job 15:34 of company of wicked men, where probably a substantive see De Di ; Job 30:3 through want and famine (they are) stiff (lifeless ; RV gaunt) ; of exiled Zion as bereaved and barren woman Isa 49:21 so of night of Job's birth Job 3:7 .
